text: 印度尼西亚投资与下游化部部长罗山表示，印尼政府将继续推行促进贸易投资、改善营商环境的政策，对中国和印尼投资合作的未来充满信心。 罗山说，印尼始终保持开放态度，致力于维护稳定、透明和友好的投资环境。近期政策调整的目标是加强产业治理、提升竞争力，并为印尼经济创造更大的长期价值，不会阻碍外国投资，更不是为了针对任何特定国家或投资伙伴。
text_en: Indonesia's Minister of Investment and Downstreaming, Rosan Roeslani, stated that the Indonesian government will continue policies to promote trade, investment, and improve the business environment, expressing full confidence in the future of China-Indonesia investment cooperation. Rosan said Indonesia remains open, committed to maintaining a stable, transparent, and friendly investment environment. Recent policy adjustments aim to strengthen industrial governance, enhance competitiveness, and create greater long-term value for Indonesia's economy, and will not hinder foreign investment, nor are they targeted at any specific country or investment partner.
